column2: Creates a `CDPClientInterface` bound to the given `CDPTransportInterface`.
Creates a navigable `BrowserSnapshotInterface` over decoded `BrowserSnapshotInput` data.
Creates a raw-CDP `BrowserInterface` façade with discovery, connection, and lifecycle management.
Creates a Node `WebSocket`-backed `CDPTransportInterface` for the given CDP debugger URL.
Creates a filesystem-backed `BrowserWriterInterface` that persists bytes through `node:fs/promises`.
Represents the base error for all browser automation operations, carrying the code `BROWSER_ERROR` and a `context` record.
Reports that a selector-based lookup or wait timed out without the element appearing, under the code `BROWSER_SELECTOR_ERROR`.
Reports that a CDP request received an error response from the remote endpoint, under the code `BROWSER_CDP_ERROR`, with the `method`, the CDP `code`, the `message`, and any `data` in its context.

Reports that a CDP request could not be sent or completed because the client was not in a connectable state — not connected, closed while connecting, or the connection dropped mid-request — under the code `BROWSER_CDP_CONNECTION_ERROR`.
Reports that a pending CDP request was not answered within its timeout window, under the code `BROWSER_CDP_TIMEOUT_ERROR`.
Reports that an `evaluate()`/`content()` result exceeded `BROWSER_RESULT_LIMIT` and was rejected in-page before it could overflow the CDP transport frame, under the code `BROWSER_RESULT_LIMIT_ERROR`.
Reports that a CDP connection, discovery, or launch attempt failed, under the code `BROWSER_CONNECTION_ERROR`.
Reports that an operation requiring an active connection was attempted while disconnected, under the code `BROWSER_NOT_CONNECTED_ERROR`.
Reports that an operation was attempted after the browser wrapper was destroyed, under the code `BROWSER_DESTROYED_ERROR`.
Narrows an unknown value to a `BrowserError`.
Narrows an unknown value to a `BrowserSelectorError`.
Narrows an unknown value to a `CDPError`.
Narrows an unknown value to a `CDPConnectionError`.
Narrows an unknown value to a `CDPTimeoutError`.
Narrows an unknown value to a `BrowserResultLimitError`.
Narrows an unknown value to a `BrowserConnectionError`.
Narrows an unknown value to a `BrowserNotConnectedError`.
Narrows an unknown value to a `BrowserDestroyedError`.
Sets the default timeout for browser connection, requests, and navigation, `30_000` milliseconds.
Sets the poll interval while waiting for a selector to appear, `100` milliseconds.
Sets the default viewport width, `1280` pixels.
Sets the default viewport height, `720` pixels.
Names the CDP runtime binding the codegen recorder script calls into, `'__orkestrelBrowserCodegen'`.
Caps the serialized-character length for an `evaluate()`/`content()` result at `2_500_000`, enforced in-page before the result is returned to CDP.
Names the distinctive prefix for the in-page result-limit sentinel error, `'[[ORKESTREL_BROWSER_RESULT_LIMIT]]'`, immediately followed by the serialized length.

Matches the in-page result-limit sentinel error message, anchored immediately after the `Error:` (optionally `Uncaught Error:`) prefix that Chromium prepends to a thrown error's description, so the guard's own throw is recognized only at the start of the message rather than wherever the substring happens to occur.
Bounds the best-effort `Page.stopLoading` call issued after a failed `navigate()` at `1_000` milliseconds.
Names the isolated world used for iframe evaluation, `'__orkestrelBrowserFrame'`.
Sets the default maximum node count accepted from a decoded CDP DOM snapshot, `100_000`.
Sets the default CDP port probed for an existing browser and used for launches, `9222`.
Sets the default host probed for an existing browser and used for launches, `'127.0.0.1'`, which avoids `localhost` resolving to `::1` when Chromium binds `127.0.0.1`.
Names the protocol prefix for CDP discovery requests, `'http'`.
Names the path appended to the CDP host to fetch version metadata, `'/json/version'`, which is where endpoint discovery reads.
Names the path appended to the CDP host to list open targets — pages, workers, and every other target category Chromium reports — `'/json/list'`.
Names the flag that enables headless mode on a launched browser process, `'--headless=new'`.
Names the prefix for isolated browser profiles created beneath the operating-system temp directory, `'orkestrel-browser-'`.
Bounds each launched-process exit window during TERM-to-KILL teardown at `3_000` milliseconds.

Bounds the `discover: false` port-occupancy probe before launching at `200` milliseconds, which is short because the probe only needs to detect an already-listening CDP endpoint rather than perform full discovery.

Defers once for `50` milliseconds when a transport loss is observed on an owned process, giving a near-simultaneous process-exit event, which libuv may reap slightly later than the socket close, first say over the diagnosis.
Names the machine-readable error-context cause for an owned browser process exiting, `'process-exit'`.
Names the machine-readable error-context cause for a CDP transport disconnecting while its browser remains alive, `'transport-loss'`.
Names the environment variable that carries an additional Playwright browser store base directory, `'PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH'`.
Names the top-level Chromium symlink or binary Playwright maintains inside a browser store base, `'chromium'`.
Compiles a `Runtime.evaluate` expression so the in-page code stringifies its own result and throws a recognizable sentinel error before an oversized result would overflow the CDP transport frame.
Normalizes recorded codegen actions, collapsing consecutive `fill` actions on the same selector into the latest value.
Coerces a `Page.frameNavigated` CDP event to a `navigate` codegen action, or `undefined` off-shape and for every frame but the top-level one.
Compiles recorded codegen actions into a replayable JavaScript or TypeScript script.
Decodes one CDP `Runtime.evaluate` result, throwing a `BrowserError` on a failed evaluation and a `BrowserResultLimitError` past the guarded result size.
Decodes a flattened CDP `Page.getFrameTree` result into depth-first frame metadata, skipping every off-shape frame.
Decodes CDP snapshot sparse string data into a node-index map, skipping every off-shape entry.
Decodes CDP snapshot sparse boolean data into a set of node indexes, skipping every off-shape entry.
Decodes CDP snapshot sparse integer data into a node-index map, skipping every off-shape entry.
Coerces a four-number CSS-pixel rectangle to a `BrowserRect`, or `undefined` off-shape.
Decodes flattened CDP node attributes into a frozen record, skipping every off-shape pair.
Decodes a CDP `DOMSnapshot.captureSnapshot` result into a serializable `BrowserSnapshotInput`, throwing a `BrowserError` off-shape and a `BrowserResultLimitError` past the configured node limit.
Tests whether a browser-node matcher is a declarative query rather than a predicate.
Fetches the current CDP target list from a browser's `/json/list` endpoint, as a `Result` carrying either the targets or a coded `BrowserConnectionError`.
Extracts a keyboard chord such as `Control+Shift+P` into its parts, throwing a `BrowserError` on an empty chord or an unsupported modifier.
Decodes an Accessibility-domain AXValue, or `undefined` when the record carries none.
Decodes Accessibility-domain nodes into a flat serializable tree, throwing a `BrowserError` off-shape.
Decodes one Chromium cookie, throwing a `BrowserError` off-shape.
Decodes the cookies `Storage.getCookies` returns, throwing a `BrowserError` off-shape.
Decodes and normalizes coverage ranges, throwing a `BrowserError` off-shape.
Decodes a Chromium Headers object into string values, skipping every entry that is neither a string nor a finite number.
Decodes Performance-domain metrics, throwing a `BrowserError` off-shape.
Decodes one CPU profile, throwing a `BrowserError` off-shape.
Decodes a CPU profile call frame, throwing a `BrowserError` off-shape.
Decodes the first `DOM.getContentQuads` quad and its center, throwing a `BrowserError` off-shape.
Decodes a Runtime remote object's printable value, falling back to its unserializable form and then its description, or `undefined` when it carries none.
Decodes JavaScript precise coverage, throwing a `BrowserError` off-shape.
Decodes the `Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument` result, throwing a `BrowserError` off-shape.
Decodes a Chromium runtime stack trace, skipping every off-shape call frame.
Decodes a list of web-storage entries, throwing a `BrowserError` off-shape.
Decodes one in-page web-storage snapshot, throwing a `BrowserError` off-shape.
Decodes one `IO.read` response, throwing a `BrowserError` off-shape.
Decodes CSS rule usage, throwing a `BrowserError` off-shape.
Validates the bounded delay, count, steps, and position of one trusted-input operation.
Abstracts a single top-level browser page, extending `BrowserFrameInterface` with navigation, screenshots, frame discovery, DOM snapshots, codegen, and target teardown.

Represents a navigable, serializable snapshot of every document attached to a page, extending `BrowserSnapshotInput` with walking, structural relationships, search, and path derivation over plain `BrowserNode` values.
